Header.name: Billal Benzazoua
Header.title: Frontend engineer
Header.description: I build accessible, pixel-perfect digital experiences for the web.

About.title: About Me
About.p1: I'm a Frontend Engineer focused on building thoughtful, accessible, and maintainable web applications with React and TypeScript. I care about the details—from intuitive interfaces and responsive design to clean architecture, reusable components, and reliable code.
About.p2: Currently, I work as a Frontend Engineer at <link>DataMasterDZ</link>, where I contribute to a modern ERP system that streamlines business operations. My work involves building reusable interfaces, improving frontend architecture, migrating legacy JavaScript to TypeScript, and raising code quality through reviews and testing.
About.p3: Outside of work, I build full-stack products that push me to explore new technologies and think beyond the frontend. These projects have given me hands-on experience with authentication, role-based access control, payments, real-time features, APIs, databases, and AI integrations.
About.p4: I'm always learning, experimenting, and looking for better ways to build software that is both enjoyable to use and well-engineered.

knowsphere.name: KnowSphere
knowsphere.tagline: A full-stack learning platform for browsing, enrolling in, and completing online courses — with verifiable certificates.
highlights: Course catalog with search, filters, and URL-driven state, plus free and Stripe-powered paid enrollment.
GitHub OAuth and email OTP sign-in with role-based access separating learners from administrators.
Lesson player with progress tracking, quizzes, discussions, reviews, and publicly verifiable certificates.
Admin console with analytics, full course and curriculum management, moderation, and an auditable activity log.

teamora.name: Teamora
teamora.tagline: A realtime team chat platform where teams collaborate in channels and threads, with AI-assisted writing and summaries.
highlights: Realtime messaging with channels, threads, emoji reactions, and live presence.
AI thread summaries and a compose assistant that stream and leave links and code blocks untouched.
Fully type-safe, end-to-end API so the frontend and backend stay in sync.
Secure authentication, workspace-level access control, tiered rate limiting, and soft-delete with undo.

blog-sn-next.name: Blog — Next.js + Sanity
blog-sn-next.tagline: A server-rendered blog powered by Next.js and Sanity CMS, with fast static pages and an in-repo content studio.
highlights: Statically generated pages with ISR, refreshing content every 10 minutes.
Sanity Studio lives in the repo as a pnpm workspace member, sharing one lockfile.
Typed GROQ queries, dark mode, and real per-post SEO metadata.

git-finder.name: GitFinder
git-finder.tagline: A GitHub user explorer for browsing repositories, forks, followers, and following — with a mobile-first UI.
highlights: Search any GitHub user with debounced input and skeleton loading.
Paged repository lists with a load-more button and dark/light themes.

weatherio.name: Weatherio
weatherio.tagline: A weather app with current conditions and 5-day forecasts for cities worldwide, powered by OpenWeatherMap.
highlights: Today's highlights: air quality, sunrise & sunset, humidity, pressure, visibility, and feels-like.
Debounced search with suggestions, geolocation, and shareable URL state.
API key kept server-side through Next.js route handlers.

react-admin-dashboard.name: React Admin Dashboard
react-admin-dashboard.tagline: A dark-themed admin dashboard with management pages, charts, and animations — all driven by mock data.
highlights: Overview, products, users, sales, orders, analytics, and settings pages.
Recharts visualizations, Framer Motion transitions, and an animated collapsible sidebar.
Sortable-style tables with search, row actions, and toast notifications.

blog.name: Blog API
blog.tagline: The backend of a blog platform — REST API with JWT authentication, validation, and OpenAPI documentation. Frontend in progress.
highlights: Express REST API under /api/v1 with role-based authorization middleware.
Zod validation with an auto-generated OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI.
Vitest test suite running against an in-memory MongoDB.

tvflix-next.name: Tvflix
tvflix-next.tagline: A movie browser built on the TMDB API with trending, top-rated, and genre discovery.
highlights: Home hero slider plus upcoming, trending, and top-rated sections.
Movie detail pages with trailers and recommendations.
All TMDB calls stay server-side; the API key never reaches the client.

stock-media-platform-next.name: Stock Media Platform
stock-media-platform-next.tagline: A stock media gallery for browsing photos and videos via the Pexels API.
highlights: Search, curated, and popular feeds for photos, videos, and collections.
Favorites with local persistence, infinite scroll, and a masonry grid.
Filter bar, media detail pages, and downloads.

pure-js-image-slider.name: Image Slider
pure-js-image-slider.tagline: A minimal, dependency-free image slider built with plain JavaScript.
highlights: Pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no frameworks.

music-player.name: Music Player
music-player.tagline: A responsive, mobile-first music player with playback controls and keyboard shortcuts.
highlights: Play/pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, and volume controls.
Keyboard shortcuts for playback and quick actions.

nike.name: Nike Landing Page
nike.tagline: A modern, responsive landing page for a sports brand, built with React and Tailwind.
highlights: Clean, contemporary UI with fully responsive layouts.

sneakers-ecommerce.name: Sneakers E-commerce
sneakers-ecommerce.tagline: A two-page sneaker storefront with sliders and scroll animations.
highlights: BEM-structured CSS with Swiper sliders, Boxicons, and ScrollReveal animations.

brainwave.name: Brainwave
brainwave.tagline: An AI-focused landing page with immersive parallax effects.
highlights: Parallax effects via react-just-parallax and scroll behavior control.

travelia.name: Travelia
travelia.tagline: A mobile-first travel landing page for showcasing destinations.
highlights: Clean, elegant layout built with semantic HTML and vanilla JavaScript.

sushi.name: Sushi
sushi.tagline: An elegant sushi restaurant page with scroll-reveal animations.
highlights: AOS scroll animations over a clean, responsive design.

html-css-template-three.name: Template Three
html-css-template-three.tagline: A fully responsive static website template with a modern design.
highlights: Built with semantic HTML, custom CSS, and Font Awesome icons.

nftc.name: NFTC
nftc.tagline: A mobile-first NFT marketplace landing page.
highlights: Clean, modern design with Ionicons and cross-browser compatibility.

covid-19.name: COVID-19 Info
covid-19.tagline: A mobile-first website presenting COVID-19 information.
highlights: Clear, user-friendly layout with Ionicons and full responsiveness.

evara-ecommerce.name: Evara E-commerce
evara-ecommerce.tagline: A responsive e-commerce website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
highlights: Modern, product-focused layout adapting to all screen sizes.

simple-cool-projects.name: Simple Cool Projects
simple-cool-projects.tagline: A collection of small, fun HTML/CSS/JS experiments.
highlights: Mini apps and UI widgets in vanilla JavaScript.

car.name: Autofix
car.tagline: A responsive car service website built with a mobile-first approach.
highlights: Well-structured semantic markup with organized, maintainable CSS.

metalink-nft.name: Metalink NFT
metalink-nft.tagline: An NFT collections landing page with an interactive slider and accordion FAQ.
highlights: Top-collections slider, accordion Q&A, and a header revealed on scroll.

grilli-restaurant.name: Grilli Restaurant
grilli-restaurant.tagline: A restaurant website with a preloader, hero slider, and parallax effects.
highlights: Auto-rotating hero slider with manual navigation and shine hover effects.

exp1.name: DataMasterDZ
exp1.description: Frontend Engineer on a modern ERP system.
highlights: Unified multiple independently developed ERP frontends into a single codebase with a shared, feature-based architecture, reducing duplication and improving consistency across modules.
Initiated and led the migration of 8 ERP modules from JavaScript to TypeScript, improving type safety and maintainability.
Built a reusable component system and shared frontend patterns for consistent, low-duplication feature development.
Introduced code reviews plus unit and end-to-end testing, strengthening quality, maintainability, and regression confidence.

exp2.name: Intern2Grow
exp2.description: Completed a virtual internship across UI, JavaScript, and React tracks, taking on real tasks from design to delivery.
highlights: UI: Converted Figma designs into responsive pages, including a login screen and a portfolio page.
JavaScript: Fixed bugs and implemented new features, including debounced search, clipboard copy, and localStorage auto-save.
React: Built new features such as social share buttons and a custom useLocalStorage hook.
